body:
CURRENT ENGRAM RUN RULE (Engram::Fable; rev 11, 2026-11-01 06:28Z, compacted; history is in revisions 1-10).
SOURCE: GREG DIRECT via Engram::Advisor #2499 (message 7dab37f3, 2026-10-31 22:46:24Z), verbatim: "Greg sugeruje podzial pracy: Windows A do kodowania zmian i przygotowania paczek; test runy na pozostalych maszynach remote. Prosze organizowac wszystkie mozliwe focused i full runs na DL560/Mac/Windows B przez natywne sesje i mailbox, Windows B dla testow zależnych od Windows. Central tylko gdy istnieje konkretna techniczna potrzeba. Nie dokladac recznych procedur; podajcie realne uruchomienia i usuncie sztuczne ograniczenia."
SUPERSEDES the per-job GO registry in dl560-runner-checklist (its isolation and census rules still apply).

1. Windows A (Central): coding and packaging. Cargo there only for a named concrete technical need, asked of Termal::Fable2.
2. Jobs go DIRECTLY from any Engram coder or merger to a runner, by native mail: a git bundle of the exact commit, the tree and the command. NO coordinator GO. The runner's census is the only admission rule. One fresh worktree and target per job; no retry of unchanged input without a concrete reason; senders outside Engram and TermAl are refused; ENDs go to the sender (full-gate ENDs are copied to Fable).
3. RUNNERS:
- Mac 6201 (host:abf8bda6-1ac7-485c-91ce-5a06ac453653::session-6201, clone /Users/greg/GitHub/Personal/Engram-runner): the PRIMARY Unix lane while DL560 is down. One job at a time, FIFO, ≥60 GB free after the job's footprint.
- Windows B (host:932a546b-4ab2-49a7-a5cb-499cbfac2eab::session-9): Windows-dependent tests and full gates. At most 1 full OR 2 focused jobs, ≥25 GiB free commit (agreed with Fable2 #5725).
- DL560 (host:e83d08f4-22ac-4655-a84d-941fc0eeb4f1): Engram runners session-1 "Codex Live" (Greg: "TAK, pracuj!!", write scope only /home/greg/github/Engram-runner, job prefix s1-) and session-4 (Claude, new account, prefix s4-); TermAl runner session-3 (own clone Engram-runner/tc, protected). Census: MemAvailable ≥64 GiB, disk ≥60 GB plus footprint, load <64, CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=48. UNREACHABLE since ~01:00Z 2026-11-01 (409/503 "peer not connected"; TermAl w-3bddbf73af2a; Greg must reconnect). Nothing was delivered there after that.
4. STANDING RUNNER CLEANUP (03:27Z): when the census refuses an Engram job for space, the runner may delete, without asking, the Cargo build output (target/debug and other profile dirs under a job's own target/) of Engram jobs whose END it already sent, oldest first, only as much as needed. Paths are resolved to absolute paths inside the runner clone and checked, no symlinks out. KEEP worktrees, target/tmp and home, *-input, review-runs, logs and fixtures. NEVER an active job, the protected TermAl lane (only Fable2 releases that) or S3. Each deletion is logged in .logs/ and reported in the next END.
5. MAC TERMAL STANDING RULE (06:27Z, with Fable2 #5776/#5777): until DL560 reconnects, the Mac takes TermAl full gates and focused jobs from Fable2 or a worker he names, with no per-job OK. FIFO with Engram jobs, at most ONE TermAl job queued or running, protected TermAl lane (.worktrees/ta*, kept until Fable2 releases it), normal census, TermAl-lane cleanup rules. Revisit if Engram's queue backs up.
6. Withdrawals: a sender withdraws a never-started job and the runner confirms "withdrawn, not started" BEFORE the job is resent elsewhere; a job is never run twice.
7. Runners have no Engram tracker route: owners (or Fable) record ENDs and gates on the items.
RECENT FACTS: 04:28Z Engram master ca55989c (w-7473 + w-f4fbd5b842bc) landed after Mac full test-83c51d91 and Windows B full test-7d05c0b9. TermAl w-5dcb0deb40f1 (macOS killpg EPERM cleanup) passed Mac full test-23e9dcb1 on 2ab026a3.

17:15Z AFTER THE TERMAL CENTRAL RESTART (build 3ed6f4cb, ~17:00Z): ALL THREE lanes are reachable. DL560 session-1 reconnected (idle, 553 GiB free; its stale 59fbb1cf was dropped as "ran elsewhere"; it runs 11330's 5a870119). Windows B is idle. The Mac's native send gave a transient 409 at 17:06Z and was accepted at 17:15Z. The Mac is again an ordinary Unix lane next to DL560 (no longer the sole primary). The one-off priority for TermAl's w-8ec0 isolation gate on the Mac stands. The DL560 rule (§3) applies again: census MemAvailable ≥64 GiB, disk ≥60 GB plus footprint, load <64, CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=48. The standing cleanup (§4) and lean END copies apply on all lanes.

2026-11-06 05:56Z, agreed with Termal::Fable2 (#6696/#6697) after a collision. The Engram FULL test-32fcac34 started on DL560 at 05:48Z while TermAl's N31 FULL test-758df116 was running; TermAl stopped N31. RULE: DL560 has ONE shared FULL queue for both projects. Before STARTING any FULL on DL560, the Engram runner (and any Engram coder dispatching one) obtains a named slot GO from Termal::Opus2 (session-8111). Focused jobs keep the runner's own census. The earlier collision the other way (TermAl's FULL overlapping Engram's test-4519a4a0 at 01:08Z) is the same failure mode.
